title: 1. Understand the business
text: Udyam Digital helps a small business choose and order digital services in one journey. Here, a fictional clinic has eight employees and a monthly budget of two thousand one hundred rupees. The owner chooses internet and business email. All source records in this demonstration are synthetic.

title: 2. Live Groq advisor
text: The advisor is connected to Groq for testing. It explains the package in plain language and returns structured business details. The application checks monetary values against the catalogue quote. The owner reviews any proposed changes before continuing. Provider failures use a clearly labelled guided fallback.

title: 3. Catalogue pricing and editable quantities
text: The quote uses a one hundred megabit fibre plan at nine hundred ninety nine rupees and eight email accounts at one hundred twenty five rupees each. The monthly total is one thousand nine hundred ninety nine rupees, before taxes. Quantities and eligible add-ons can be edited. Setup fees, minimum contract and typical installation time remain visible.

title: 4. English and Hindi controls
text: The language selector changes the customer controls, service descriptions and review messages into Hindi. Product names remain the names in the supplied catalogue. The advisor also supports Hindi conversation. The same server rules continue to check prices and eligibility in either language.

title: 5. Consent before document processing
text: The owner adds contact and installation details, then explicitly agrees to verification. Local reading keeps the document images on this computer. Manual review is also available. External image reading stays disabled for this Groq text-model setup, and would require separate consent and configuration.

title: 6. Real local reading and honest review results
text: The app reads an actual address-proof image from the supplied test pack. This fictional clinic does not match that document, and a signatory document is missing. The app therefore requests assisted review. It does not turn a selected file into a successful identity check. Registry and date checks use the case's fixed reference date.

title: 7. Saved order and refreshable tracker
text: The owner can save this order for assisted review. Refreshing the browser preserves the order number, quote and outstanding issues. The tracker clearly says that installation is not yet scheduled. This prototype does not contact a real partner or book a physical installation.

title: 8. Privacy and submission evidence
text: Privacy choices explain local reading, optional external processing and seven-day session retention. Raw images are not saved, and identifiers are masked in the check results. The submission also includes a business presentation, an architecture diagram and aggregate evidence from five thousand fictional leads. Pilot improvements are targets, not achieved results.
